_meta.theme: calibration: re-run max-turns-probe with raised cap (12) to verify happy path; plus investigate/finalize max_turns recommendations in docs
_meta.design: Round-18 showed max_turns: 6 is too tight for write+commit+gate (bash, edit, git add/commit) on slow pools. This round verifies 12 is enough and documents the calibration.

tasks.title: r19-max-turns-calibration: verify max_turns=12 is enough for a write+commit+gate task. Look for any docs that still recommend 6 and update them to 12-16. Add a note to README.md max_turns row: 'Suggest 12-16 for write+commit+gate tasks; 6 Often too tight.'. Prior r18 task (r18-max-turns-probe) failed with 6 turns (knob verified); now try 12.
tasks.accept: grep -q 'Suggest 12-16 for write' README.md && grep -q 'max_turns' README.md
